title: 7 years of self-improvement lessons in *seven slides*

label: LESSON #1
head: Small daily beats huge once a month
sub: 20 pushups every day beats one brutal gym session a month.

label: LESSON #2
head: Your environment beats your willpower
sub: Phone in another room does more than any app blocker.

label: LESSON #3
head: Most advice is just entertainment
sub: If you've watched 10 videos on it, you don't need an 11th. You need to do it.

label: LESSON #4
head: Sleep fixes more than supplements
sub: 8 real hours beats any pre-workout, nootropic or morning routine.

label: LESSON #5
head: Your friends set your ceiling
sub: Spend more time with people one step ahead of you.

label: LESSON #6
head: Progress looks like nothing for months
sub: Then it shows up all at once. Most guys quit right before it does.

label: LESSON #7
head: You will never feel ready
sub: Start before you're ready. Confidence shows up after, not before.

head: Save this. *Reread it in a year.*
